notes: Two taḥwīl shaykhs converge at «قالا حدثنا أمية بن خالد»; the tail after them is shared
«- واللفظ لابن المثنى -» is an editor's gloss and is left out
«قال ابن المثنى قلت لأمية» is an explanation of one word, not a route; it is left out
Ibn Abbas's first-person account is a Companion's own narration; the chain ends at him
